featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Khire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely unprofessional behavior. They don’t pick up calls during normal business hours and claim they are out of town and only available via text, yet reply on Sunday saying it’s their holiday. They quoted Rs. 12L for a 3-day event including photography and a wedding film, but when I asked what the videography actually includes (short reel, documentary, trailer, etc.), the only response was, “Yes, videography is included.” That level of communication is unacceptable for a service at this price point.

When I raised concerns, they asked for my email to send details even though a PDF could easily be shared on WhatsApp. Only after I said I cannot manage such important discussions over text did they agree to a phone call, and even then the tone felt like they were doing me a favor while on holiday. If you’re on holiday, don’t respond. I’ve dealt with far more reputed and well-known vendors who communicate far more professionally.

featured_reviews.name: priya pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Where do I even begin? Working with SPClicks was hands down one of the best decisions we made for our wedding. From the very first meeting, I felt like we weren’t just hiring a photographer—we were gaining a friend. They made everything feel so natural and easy, which is a blessing when you’re already stressed with wedding planning!

On our wedding day, they were there every step of the way, capturing not just the big moments but the little ones that really meant the most. The moments when I was tearing up during magalsutra ceremony, the way my partner looked at me during our vows—those tiny, perfect details that we’ll cherish forever. And the way they made sure we were always comfortable, laughing, and having fun—every shot felt so personal and meaningful.

After the wedding, we also asked them to capture a cocktail celebrations, and each time they showed up with the same level of warmth and creativity. They have this incredible ability to make everyone feel at ease, which is such a gift when you want authentic, genuine photos. Each picture felt like a beautiful memory frozen in time.

If you want someone who truly cares about capturing your story in the most beautiful, genuine way, I can’t recommend SPClicks enough. They have a rare gift, and I’ll be forever grateful for the beautiful moments they’ve captured for us. Thank you for everything—you’ve made our memories even more magical!
